page.heading: Collection Methods
page.caption: Templates that define how you collect from clients.

tabs.stagePending: This section is coming in a later release.

form.name: Name
form.nameInfo: A short, recognizable name for this method template. Customers don't see it.
form.categoryInfo: What kind of method this is. Determines which settings appear below. Cannot be changed once the first issuance has been made.
form.postingKindInfo: How collections through this method are recorded in your books.
form.audienceModeInfo: Which customers are allowed to be issued from this method.
form.taxEffectInfo: Whether amounts include or exclude tax at the point of issuance.
form.templateCodeInfo: Stable code shared across revisions of this template.

fragment.cardIntro: This sets up which cards you accept. When a customer saves a card, it's stored against that customer — the card number, last four, and expiry stay with the saved card, not here.
fragment.voucherIntro: This is a voucher program — the template for a batch of vouchers, like a gift-card campaign. The settings below are just the starting defaults for each voucher you issue.
fragment.advanceIntro: This is an advance template — for customer prepayments. The settings below are the starting defaults for each prepayment you record.
fragment.cashIntro: Cash methods aren't issued to individual customers — they're a plain cash flow. There's nothing extra to set up here.
fragment.bankIntro: This sets up the kind of bank account you accept. A customer's actual account details are saved against that customer, not here.
